# Relynked

> Relynked is a business app for small businesses in Nigeria: shops, salons, food vendors and one-venue lounges. It keeps what you sell, your stock, your staff, your orders and your payments in one place, and Remy, the assistant inside it, answers customers on WhatsApp in English or Pidgin. It is made by Relynked Ltd (RC 9837720) in Benin City, Edo State.

- Who it is for: small businesses in Nigeria that sell products or book services (shops, supermarkets, clothing and shoe sellers, phone shops, bakeries, grills, bukas, restaurants, bars and lounges, hair salons, barbers, makeup artists, nail and lash technicians, spas, car washes).
- Price, in Nigerian naira: Basic ₦20,000 a month, Standard ₦40,000 a month, Enterprise from ₦150,000 a month (agreed after a call). Quarterly: ₦57,000 (Basic), ₦114,000 (Standard). Yearly: ₦200,000 (Basic), ₦400,000 (Standard).
- Free trial: 7 days, no card needed.
- Staff: unlimited on every plan. The plan counts only the people who answer customers on the business's WhatsApp number or use Remy: the owner plus 2 on Basic, plus 5 on Standard, plus 10 on Enterprise.
- No percentage of sales and no fee per transaction. Meta's charges for some WhatsApp messages are separate from the plan.
- Relynked does not hold customers' money: customers pay the business through a licensed payment company.
- Sign up: https://app.relynked.com/ (no card needed).
- Contact: hello@relynked.com, 0911 567 1307, 7B Edegbe Street, off Giwa-Amu Street, GRA, Benin City, Edo State, Nigeria.
